For aspiring doctors in India and other countries, the dream of pursuing an MBBS (Bachelor of Medicine and Bachelor of Surgery) in Kyrgyzstan for Indian Students can be inhibited by high costs and competitive entrance exams. To avoid all these things, students can apply to Study MBBS abroad. 

Kyrgyzstan, a beautiful nation nestled in Central Asia, offers an attractive alternative with its well-established medical universities, affordable tuition fees, and international recognition. Presently, there are more than 10,000 students who come to study MBBS in Kyrgyzstan every year.  

The medium of instruction is English. Kyrgyzstan has various WHO-recognized medical universities. With its diverse cultures and welcoming nature, Kyrgyzstan offers a unique and excellent study experience. In this blog, we cover a comprehensive guide for students considering MBBS in Kyrgyzstan for Indian students. We’ll describe the following aspects:

Table of Content

  • Benefits of Studying MBBS in Kyrgyzstan
  • Top Medical Universities in Kyrgyzstan (including details on fees)
  • Eligibility Criteria for Admission
  • Admission Process: Step-by-Step
  • Additional Considerations: Living Costs and Scholarships

Benefits of Studying MBBS in Kyrgyzstan for Indian students–

Here’s a glimpse of what makes Kyrgyzstan a compelling choice for MBBS aspirants:

  • Affordable Fees: Compared to MBBS programs in Western countries and even some Asian nations, Kyrgyzstan boasts significantly lower tuition fees. This makes quality medical education accessible to a wider range of students.
  • English Medium Instruction: Most medical universities in Kyrgyzstan offer the entire MBBS program in English, eliminating the language barrier for international students.
  • Globally Recognized Degrees: Medical degrees awarded by universities recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) or other international bodies like WHO are valid for practicing medicine in many countries after clearing necessary licensing exams.
  • Focus on Practical Training: Kyrgyz medical universities emphasize practical training alongside theoretical knowledge, providing students with valuable clinical experience.
  • Safe and Welcoming Environment: Kyrgyzstan is known for its friendly culture and welcoming atmosphere for international students.

Top Medical Universities in Kyrgyzstan 

Here’s a list of some of the top medical universities in Kyrgyzstan, along with their approximate annual tuition fees. Kyrgyzstan has six NMC/MCI-approved medical universities. 

  • Osh State University: Established in 1993, OSU is a highly regarded university with a long history of excellence in medical education. It is a public university located in OSH, Kyrgyzstan. 
  • Asian Medical Institute: It’s a newly established university. The Asian Medical Institute was established in 2004. Currently, the university has more than 1900 international students from more than 10 countries, including India. 
  • Jalal-Abad State University: Located in the city of Jalal-Abad, JSU provides a comprehensive MBBS program with experienced faculty. WHO and NMC recognize the university. 
  • International Higher School of Medicine: The university is a renowned private medical university known for its modern facilities and international collaborations. 
  • Kyrgyz State Medical Academy: Established in 1939, it is one of the oldest universities in the nation. The university has 540 world-class faculty members. 

Eligibility Criteria for Admission

To be eligible for admission to MBBS in Kyrgyzstan, you must fulfill the following criteria: 

  • The minimum age is 17 years old and the maximum is 25 years old at the time of admission.
  • Completion of 10+2 education (senior secondary school) with a minimum of 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (minimum marks may vary depending on the university).
  • For Indian students, a qualifying score in the NEET (National Eligibility and Entrance Test) is mandatory.

Admission Process: Step-by-Step 

The admission process for MBBS in Kyrgyzstan for Indian Students typically involves these steps:

Step 1: Choose Your University: Research and select the university that best suits your requirements and budget.

Step 3: Apply Online: Submit your application form along with necessary documents like mark sheets, certificates, NEET scorecards (for Indian students), and a valid passport. 

Step 4: Receive an Invitation Letter: Upon successful application review, the university will send you an invitation letter for visa processing.

Step 5: Apply for a Visa: Apply for a student visa at the Kyrgyz embassy or consulate in your home country.

Step 6: Travel and Registration: Once your visa is approved, you can arrange your travel to Kyrgyzstan and complete the registration process at the university.


Additional Considerations: Cost of Living and Scholarships

The cost of living in Kyrgyzstan is relatively inexpensive compared to many other countries. Here’s a breakdown of some estimated expenses:

Accommodation: USD 200–400 per month (shared apartment)

Food: USD 150-200 per month

Transportation: USD 50 per month.

Some universities in Kyrgyzstan offer scholarships to meritorious students, helping to further reduce the financial burden. It’s advisable to research scholarship opportunities offered by the universities you’re interested in.

posts.title: Conquering the NEET UG 2024: A Comprehensive Guide
posts.content:
The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) Undergraduate is a highly competitive exam for aspiring medical professionals in India. Cracking NEET grants admission to coveted MBBS, BDS, and other medical courses across the country. 

As per the reports, the total number of applicants for the the NEET UG 2024 exam received around 25 lakhs. Which is the highest number in the few past years. NEET is the only admission exam available in India for undergraduate programs in medicine and paramedicine. 

With the exam date approaching on May 5th, 2024, this blog serves as a one-stop guide for NEET UG 2024 aspirants. We’ll delve into the latest updates, exam patterns, admit card details, and everything you need to know to succeed.

Latest Updates (as of May 3rd, 2024):

  • The NEET UG 2024 exam will be conducted on Sunday, May 5th, 2024.
  • The National Testing Agency (NTA) has confirmed there will be no change in the exam date despite the ongoing Lok Sabha elections.
  • The application window closed on March 16th, 2024.
  • The admit cards were released on May 1st, 2024. Candidates can download them from the official NTA website: https://nta.ac.in/

NEET UG 2024 Highlights 

NEET UG 2024 Exam Pattern

  • The NEET UG exam is a single-day, offline (pen and paper-based) test.
  • It comprises four subjects: Physics, Chemistry, Botany, and Zoology.
  • Each subject holds 70 marks, for a total of 720 marks.
  • Every subject is divided into two sections: A and B.
    • Section A: 35 questions (140 marks) – compulsory attempt for all.
    • Section B: 15 questions (45 marks) – attempt any 10 questions.
  • The exam duration is 3 hours and 20 minutes.
  • All questions are Multiple Choice Questions (MCQs) with four answer choices.

NEET UG Registration Process (for future reference):

  • The registration window typically opens in February and closes in March.
  • Registration is done online through the NTA website.
  • You’ll need to create an account, fill out the application form, upload scanned documents (photograph, signature, etc.), and pay the application fees.
  • Carefully review all details before submitting the application form.

NEET UG 2024 Admit Card:

  • The NEET exam admit card is your essential entry document for the exam hall.
  • Download it from the official NTA NEET website using your application number and date of birth.
  • Ensure all details on the admit card are accurate, including your name, photograph, exam center address, and exam timings.
  • Carry a printout of the admit card along with a valid photo ID proof to the exam venue.

NEET UG 2024 Exam Result:

  • The expected result declaration date for NEET UG 2024 is June 4th, 2024.
  • The results will be available on the NTA website.
  • You’ll need your application number and password to access your scorecard.
  • The scorecard will display your marks obtained in each subject and your overall NEET UG rank.

Preparation Tips for NEET UG exam

  • Start your preparation early: Begin with a well-structured study plan at least a year before the exam.
  • Focus on understanding concepts: Don’t just memorize facts. Strive to understand the core principles behind each topic.
  • Practice with mock tests and previous year’s papers: Familiarize yourself with the exam format and time management strategies.
  • Join a coaching institute (optional): Coaching institutes can provide valuable guidance and structured learning materials.
  • Maintain a healthy routine: Get adequate sleep, eat nutritious food, and exercise regularly to stay focused and energized.
  • Manage stress effectively: Take breaks, practice relaxation techniques, and stay positive throughout your preparation.

By following these guidelines and staying updated with the latest information, you’ll be well on your way to conquering the NEET UG 2024 exam. Remember, success in the NEET exam requires dedication, hard work, and a strategic approach. We wish you the very best in your medical entrance exam journey!

Further Resources:

  • National Testing Agency (NTA) Official Website: https://nta.ac.in/
  • NEET UG Syllabus and Sample Papers: You can find these resources on the NTA website or through various educational portals.

Remember: This information is accurate as of May 3rd, 2024. It’s always advisable to stay updated with official announcements from the NTA website for any changes or clarifications.

 Frequently Asked Questions

What are the eligibility criteria for the the NEET UG exam?

As per the eligibility criteria for the NEET exam students should pass the 12th class with 50% marks in PCB, and 40 % required for the SC/ST/OBC and reserved category students. Candidates must be 17 years old to attempt this exam.

The NEET exam is the gateway to admission in multiple medical paramedical courses. There are so many courses available after NEET UG, as we mentioned in the list below:
MBBS
BDA
BSc Nursing 
BAMS
BUMS
BPT
BHMS, etc.

Who will conduct the NEET exam every year?

The National Testing Agency (NTA) will conduct the NEET exam. The Indian government has verified NTA.

Why Consider MBBS in Georgia?

Georgia, a beautiful European country nestled between Asia and Europe, is fast becoming a preferred destination for international medical students, particularly from India. Here’s a breakdown of the key attractions:

  • Affordability: Compared to the skyrocketing costs of private medical colleges in India, MBBS in Georgia offers a significant financial advantage. The MBBS fees in Georgia typically range between $4,000 and $8,000 per year, making it a much more accessible option.
  • Globally Recognized Education: Universities in Georgia boast modern facilities, experienced faculty, and a curriculum that adheres to international medical education standards. The degree is recognized by the Medical Council of India (MCI) after clearing the Foreign Medical Graduates Examination (FMGE).
  • English Medium Instruction: No need to worry about a language barrier! Most universities in Georgia offer MBBS programs entirely in English, eliminating the need for additional language studies.
  • Focus on Practical Training: The curriculum in Georgia emphasizes practical training alongside theoretical knowledge. This ensures students gain valuable clinical experience, preparing them for the real world of medicine.
  • Safe and Secure Environment: Georgia is known for its welcoming atmosphere and safety for international students. The cost of living is also relatively low, making it easier to manage your expenses.

Pathway to Global Opportunities: An MBBS degree from Georgia opens doors to pursuing further specialization or practicing medicine in various countries after clearing the necessary licensing exams.

Is MBBS in Georgia Right for Indian Students?

Absolutely! Indian students seeking a high-quality medical education at an affordable cost will find Georgia to be an excellent fit. Here’s what makes it particularly appealing:

Culturally Rich Environment: Georgia offers a vibrant culture with a welcoming atmosphere for Indian students. You’ll find a supportive community and opportunities to explore a new part of the world.

Eligibility Criteria for MBBS in Georgia

To be eligible for MBBS in Georgia, you’ll need to meet the following requirements:

  • NEET qualification (required by MCI for practicing medicine in India).

As mentioned earlier, the fees for MBBS in Georgia are significantly lower compared to private medical colleges in India. The yearly tuition fees typically range between $4,000 and $8,000, with some variation depending on the university. The total MBBS fees in Georgia range from $24,000 to $48,000, making it a very budget-friendly option.

If you’re an Indian student with a dream of becoming a doctor and are looking for an affordable and internationally recognized MBBS program, Georgia offers a compelling opportunity. Research universities, connect with admissions counselors, and ensure you meet the eligibility criteria. With careful planning and the right guidance, MBBS in Georgia can be the perfect launchpad for your rewarding medical career.

Is Georgia cheap for MBBS?

Yes, Georgian medical universities are cheaper in other nation countries. If you are planning to study MBBS in Georgia your budget goes from 4,000 USD to 8,000 USD per year. 

What is the duration of MBBS in Georgia?


MBBS duration in Georgia is 6 years including internship program. There are 5 years when universities give theoretical study knowledge and last year provided practical training in affiliated hospitals.

Can I practice in India after studying MBBS in Georgia?

Yes, after completing the MBBS in Georgia clear FMGE exam then you are eligible to practice in India. It’s a licensing exam that needs to be cracked to practice in India.

posts.title: MBBS Abroad Without NEET 2024 – Top Countries, Eligibility, Advantages, Fees
posts.content:
A single test shouldn’t ground the dream of becoming a doctor. If the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET) has you feeling stuck, fret not! Studying MBBS abroad in 2024 can be your gateway to a fulfilling medical career. This blog offers a roadmap to navigate this exciting path. Here you get all the information about MBBS abroad without NEET. 

Important Update: NEET and Studying MBBS Abroad

As of 2024, the Indian government has made NEET mandatory for students seeking to pursue MBBS studies overseas who wish to practice medicine in India upon return. However, this requirement doesn’t apply if you plan to practice in the host country or elsewhere that doesn’t mandate NEET.

Eligibility Criteria: First Steps to Your Medical Journey

While you bypass the NEET exam, there are other eligibility benchmarks to meet:

  • Academic Qualification: You’ll need to have passed your 10+2 board exams with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as core subjects. Aim for a minimum aggregate score of 50% (requirements may vary by university).
  • Age: Most universities require you to be at least 17 years old at the time of application.
  • English Language Proficiency: Since many MBBS programs abroad are taught in English, you’ll need to take and score well on tests like IELTS or TOEFL.

Top Countries for MBBS Studies Without NEET

Several countries offer excellent medical universities that don’t require NEET. Here are a few popular destinations:

  • Asia: Countries like Russia, Kazakhstan, the UK, Germany, Bangladesh, and China offer MBBS programs at affordable costs. Some universities in these countries also provide medical courses without NEET. Keep in mind that language barriers might exist in some universities. 
  • Philippines: Many medical schools in the Philippines have globally recognized degrees and don’t require NEET.

Choosing the Right University: Due Diligence Is Key

With a plethora of options, choosing the ideal university can be overwhelming. Here are some factors that need to be considered:

  • University Recognition: Ensure the university is recognized by international medical bodies like the World Health Organization (WHO) and the National Medical Commission (NMC). This ensures the degree’s global validity.
  • Course Structure and Curriculum: Research the program’s curriculum, teaching methodology, and clinical exposure opportunities.
  • Faculty Credentials: A strong faculty with real-world experience is crucial for a well-rounded medical education.
  • Cost and Living Expenses: MBBS programs abroad can vary significantly in cost. Factor in tuition fees, living expenses, and health insurance.

The Application Process: A Step-by-Step Guide

Once you’ve shortlisted universities, it’s time to apply! Here’s a general process to follow (individual universities might have variations):

  • Gather Documents: Prepare academic transcripts, mark sheets, a valid passport, English language test scores, letters of recommendation, and a compelling statement of purpose.
  • Apply Online: Most universities have online application portals. Carefully fill out the forms and submit the required documents.
  • Entrance Exams (if applicable): If the university requires entrance exams like UKCAT or BMAT, prepare and take them well in advance.
  • Visa Application: Once accepted, apply for a student visa for the chosen country. The university might guide this process.

Benefits of Studying MBBS abroad without NEET 

  • Avoid the NEET exam: The NEET exam in India is highly competitive, with thousands of students vying for a limited number of seats in medical colleges. Studying MBBS abroad allows you to bypass this stressful process and focus on meeting the entrance requirements of the university you’d like to attend.
  • International exposure: Studying MBBS in Abroad exposes you to different teaching methodologies, healthcare systems, and cultural experiences. This broadens your perspective and can be a valuable asset in your future medical career.

Studying MBBS Abroad: An Investment in Your Future

Studying MBBS abroad without NEET opens doors to a world-class medical education. By carefully planning, researching, and following these steps, you can turn your dream of becoming a doctor into a reality. Remember, this path requires dedication and hard work, but the rewards of a fulfilling medical career are worth the effort. 

Frequently Asked Questions 

Can I go for MBBS abroad without NEET?

Yes, why not foreign countries have so many universities that accept students without NEET exams and the fees are also budget-friendly so that any student can do it. 

Which country offers the MBBS program without NEET?

Various countries accept MBBS without NEET such as Russia, China, Bangladesh, and so on. 

What are the eligibility criteria for those without MBBS?

Those candidates who plan to do MBBS but are not able to clear NEET and plan to do without the NEET exam need to follow eligibility criteria. Kindly check below. 

Students need to qualify in 12th with 50% marks in PCB
Reserved category students must obtain 40% marks
Physics, chemistry, biology, and English are compulsory in 12th standard.

posts.title: Pursuing MBBS in China: A Guide for Aspiring Doctors
posts.content:
Pursuing MBBS in China has become a popular destination for international students seeking an MBBS degree. MBBS in China is popular with its affordable costs, quality education, and internationally recognized universities. China offers a compelling alternative to studying medicine in your home country. This article will explore the key aspects of obtaining an MBBS degree in China, including fees, NMC-approved universities, and other considerations.

Due to A1’s education quality at a budget-friendly cost, many candidates want to get admission to China’s universities. We all know China is known for its modern technologies as well as world-class education. 

Why is China the best place to pursue an MBBS?

There are several reasons why China is a good choice for MBBS studies:

  • Affordability: Compared to Western countries or even private medical colleges in India, the cost of an MBBS degree in China is significantly lower. Tuition fees typically range from 25 lakh to 35 lakh, with living expenses also being relatively inexpensive. 
  • Quality Education: China boasts a strong medical education system with well-equipped universities and experienced faculty. Many universities offer programs in English, making them accessible to international students.
  • Globally Recognized Degrees: Most of China’s universities are approved by the world’s leading organizations, such as the World Health Organization (WHO), the National Medical Commission (NMC), and other leading bodies. 
  • Exposure to Advanced Technology: Chinese medical institutions often have access to cutting-edge medical technology, providing valuable experience for aspiring doctors. 

Course Structure and Eligibility

The duration of the MBBS program in China is typically six years. The first five years focus on theoretical studies through classroom learning in various medical subjects. The final year is dedicated to practical training through an internship in a hospital affiliated with the university.

Eligibility Criteria for Indian Students 

To be eligible for admission to an MBBS program in China, you’ll need to meet specific requirements. These may vary depending on the university, but generally include: 

  • Completion of senior high school (Class 12) with at least 50% marks in science subjects (Physics, Chemistry, and Biology).
  • Students must be qualified for the NEET exam. 
  • There is no age limit, but the minimum age required is 17 years old.

NMC-Approved Medical Universities in China

The NMC maintains a list of foreign medical universities whose degrees are recognized for practicing medicine in India. Here are some of the prominent NMC-approved medical universities in China:

  • Beijing University of Health Science
  • Guangxi Medical University
  • Nanjing Medical University
  • Wenzhou Medical University
  • Xi’an Jiaotong University College of Medicine

It’s important to verify the NMC status of the university you choose before applying. You can find the latest list on the NMC website.

Cost of MBBS in China

As mentioned earlier, MBBS in China is significantly more affordable compared to many other countries. Here’s a breakdown of the costs:

  • Tuition Fees: Around 25 lakh to 35 lakh (fees vary from college to college) 
  • Living Expenses: $150 to $200 per month (estimated)
  • Other Expenses: Textbooks, health insurance, visa fees, etc. (may vary)

The total cost of an MBBS degree in China can range from approximately $21,000 to $38,500 for the entire program, depending on your chosen university, living expenses, and exchange rates.

Conclusion 

Studying MBBS in China offers a valuable and affordable option for aspiring doctors. With careful planning and research, you can leverage China’s strong medical education system to launch a successful career in medicine. Remember, this blog post is a starting point. Make sure to thoroughly research universities, admission requirements, and the NMC approval status before making your final decision. For more information, visit our website, AR Group of Education.

Students who are looking for an MBBS in Chinese universities can check the university eligibility criteria before.

posts.title: Advantages of studying MBBS in Russia
posts.content:
Russia is the most significant option for those who have dreamed of becoming doctors. StudyingMBBS in Russia is popular among Indian students because it provides high-quality at an affordable cost. Russia is the top 8th destination in the world for medical education. 

For Indian students aspiring to become doctors, the dream of pursuing an MBBS can often be overshadowed by the high costs of medical education in India. This is where MBBS in Russia emerges as a compelling alternative. Renowned universities, a well-structured curriculum, and a surprisingly affordable fee structure make Russia an attractive option for Indian students seeking a world-class medical degree.

Advantages of Studying MBBS in Russia 

There are several advantages to pursuing MBBS in Russia:

  • Cost-Effectiveness: Compared to Indian private medical colleges, MBBS in Russia boasts significantly lower fees. The total program cost, including tuition, hostel, and medical insurance, typically ranges between INR 14 lakhs to INR 30 lakhs for the entire six-year duration. This translates to a much more manageable financial burden for students and their families.
  • Globally Recognized Degrees:  Many Russian medical universities are recognized by prestigious organizations like the Medical Council of India (MCI) – now the National Medical Commission (NMC) – the World Health Organization (WHO), and the Educational Commission for Foreign Medical Graduates (ECFMG). 
  • This recognition ensures wider career opportunities for graduates, allowing them to practice medicine not just in India but also in other countries after clearing the necessary licensing exams.
  • High-Quality Education:  Medical universities in Russia have a long-standing tradition of excellence in medical education. The curriculum is rigorous and practical, with a strong emphasis on theoretical knowledge and clinical exposure. Many universities offer MBBS programs entirely in English, eliminating the need to learn Russian for academic purposes.
  • Exposure to a New Culture: Studying medicine in Russia provides an enriching cultural experience. Students get to immerse themselves in a vibrant and historically significant country, developing valuable life skills and broadening their horizons.

MBBS Fee in Russia for Indian Students

As mentioned earlier, MBBS fees in Russia are a major draw for Indian students. The exact cost can vary depending on the university, location, and program duration. Here’s a breakdown:

  • Tuition Fees: University tuition fees typically range from 1,70,000 RUB to 600,000 RUB per year. If we talk about MBBS fees in INR, you can complete your medical degree for 15 lakh to 40 lakhs.Note: This amount includes the hostel and the cost of living. 
  • Living Expenses:  The cost of living in Russia is generally lower compared to Western Europe. On average, students can expect to spend around USD 130 (INR 10,000) per month on food and other personal expenses.
  • Accommodation:  University hostels are a budget-friendly option for accommodation. The cost typically falls within the tuition fee bracket.

Eligibility for MBBS in Russia 

Candidates who are looking to study MBBS in Russia should keep in mind that they must fulfill the admission criteria required by the universities. To be eligible for MBBS in Russia, Indian students must fulfill the following criteria:

  • Secure a minimum of 50% aggregate marks in Physics, Chemistry, and Biology (PCB) in the Class 12 board exams.
  • Reserve category students must obtain 40% marks in the 12th grade. 
  • Qualify for the National Eligibility Entrance Test (NEET Exam) with a competitive score. 
  • Students should be at least 17 years old, minimum age, by December 31st of the admissions year. 

The Application Process

The application process for MBBS in Russia generally involves the following steps:

  • Choosing a University: Research and shortlist universities recognized by the NMC that offer MBBS programs in English.
  • Document Preparation: Collect all required documents, including academic transcripts, NEET scorecards, passports, and medical certificates.
  • University Application: Submit the application form and required documents to the chosen university.
  • Invitation Letter: Upon acceptance, the university will issue an invitation letter needed for the visa application process.
  • Visa Application: Apply for a student visa at the Russian embassy or consulate in India.

Things to Consider  

Before embarking on your MBBS journey in Russia, here are some additional factors to consider:

  • Weather Conditions: Russia can be quite cold, especially in the northern regions. Be prepared to adjust to the climate.
  • Cultural Differences:  Embrace the opportunity to learn about Russian culture and traditions.

By carefully considering these factors and planning effectively, MBBS in Russia can be a rewarding experience for Indian students seeking a world-class medical education at an affordable cost.

Why does every student want to study MBBS in Russia?

As we know, Russia is the largest country in the world. Apart from that, the nation is popular for excellent medical studies and modern technologies all over the world. Russian universities have world-class faculties that are experts in the field. 

What is the MBBS fee in Russia?

Russia is a budget-friendly nation for medical education. Those who wish to study MBBS in Russia can complete the whole medical course for between 14 lakh to 30 lakh, including all kinds of expenses. 

How many universities in Russia offer MBBS?

Russia has 54 MCI-approved universities and excellent universities to pursue MBBS.

  • Clinical training: Evaluate the university’s affiliations with hospitals for practical clinical exposure.
  • Post-graduation opportunities: Research opportunities for residency or further studies after completing MBBS in Georgia.

Conclusion

MBBS in Georgia presents a promising option for Indian students to Pursue MBBS in Abroad seeking a quality medical education at an affordable cost. posts.title: NEET PG 2024: Registration to Begin Today
posts.content:
The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test for Postgraduates, or NEET PG 2024, registration period will open today at 3 pm, according to the National Board of Examinations in Medical Sciences (NBEMS). Interested and qualified candidates may register online at nbe.edu.in and natboard.edu.in. The application procedure will be open until 11:55 p.m. on May 6.

The National Board of Examination in Medical Science (NBEMS) shall conduct the NEET-PG 2024 on June 23, 2024, on a computer-based at various test centers in India. 

Application forms for NEET PG 2024 can only be submitted online at ntaboard.edu.in from April 16th, 2024 (3 PM onwards) to May 6th, 2024 (till 11:55 pm)

Important Dates:

How to Apply for NEET PG 2024

Below, we mentioned the step-by-step process of how to apply for NEET PG 2024. 

  • Visit natboard.edu.in, the NBE’s official website.
  • Select the NEET PG 2024 link that is displayed on the main page.
  • Register, then sign in to your account.
  • After that, complete the application and pay the application fee.
  • To download the confirmation page, click the submit button.
  • For future reference, keep a physical copy of the same.

Registration Fees 

The examination fee is ₹2500 for applicants in the SC, ST, and PWD categories and ₹3500 for candidates in the General, OBC, and EWS categories. 

The required exam fee must be paid using the designated payment gateway with an Indian bank’s credit card or debit card, or with any other payment options that may be made available and listed on the website. The official (NBEMS) website can be consulted by candidates for more relevant information. 

NEET PG Exam Pattern 

NEET PG exam includes 200 multiple-choice questions, with each question having a 4-choice. Candidates need to select the correct answer out of them. The exam duration is 3 hours and 30 minutes. There will be a 25% negative marking for incorrect answers. 

Contact AR Group of Education for further information.

Kazan Federal University (KFU) is a prestigious public research university located in Kazan, the capital of the Republic of Tatarstan in Russia. Established in 1804, it is one of the oldest universities in Russia.

KFU has 14 institutes offering over 300 programs across diverse disciplines like medicine, engineering, humanities, economics, and more. It is recognized as a ‘Federal University’ by the Russian government for its educational and research excellence.

With a sprawling campus spread over 422 hectares, KFU provides world-class academic and sports infrastructure for its 45,000+ students, including over 3500 international students.

Highlights of MBBS in Kazan Federal University

  • Global Rankings – KFU is recognized as among the top 600 universities globally in QS World University Rankings. It ranks 36th in the EECA University Rankings.
  • State-of-the-art Infrastructure – KFU has an advanced campus with lecture halls equipped with multimedia, specialized laboratories, simulation facilities, libraries, hostels, and more.
  • Strong Research Focus – With over 100 research units, KFU is a leading research hub. The Universitetskaya Clinic at KFU is its clinical training base. 
  • International Collaborations – KFU engages in partnerships with over 130 universities worldwide for student & faculty exchanges and joint research.
  • Student Diversity – International students from 90+ countries study at KFU. It provides global exposure.
  • Scholarship Options – KFU offers merit-based scholarships to help students fund their education through its ‘KFU Honors’ program.

Why Select Kazan Federal University for MBBS?

Here are the key reasons why MBBS in Kazan Federal University is an excellent choice for Indian students to pursue MBBS in Abroad:

1. Globally Recognized MBBS Degree

KFU’s medical degree is globally accredited and approved by the world’s major medical councils, including MCI, WHO, ECFMG, and more. After MBBS at KFU, you can practice or pursue postgraduation anywhere in the world.

2. Extensive Clinical Training 

The advanced university clinics have 35 departments that serve 10 lakh+ patients annually. KFU also partners with the best multispecialty hospitals in Kazan to provide rigorous clinical clerkship training in diverse medical disciplines. 

3. Low Fees 

The total fees of MBBS in Kazan Federal University for Indian students is very affordable at around Rs 22-25 lakhs for the entire 6-year MBBS program. This represents a huge saving compared to private medical colleges in India.

4. No Entrance Exam

Indian students are admitted directly based on their Class 12 results without needing to take any separate entrance test for MBBS admission at Kazan Federal University.

5. Medium of Instruction in English

The medium of instruction for MBBS at KFU is English across the duration of the course. This makes it comfortable for Indian students to study MBBS in Russia.

Ranking of Kazan Federal University

Here are some of the top global and regional rankings achieved by KFU to study MBBS in Abroad:

  • 36th in EECA University Rankings 2022
  • 301-350 World Ranking – QS World University Rankings 2022
  • 551-600 World Ranking – Times Higher Education 2022
  • 35th in Impact Rankings
  • 16th in Russia as per Interfax National Ranking

These high rankings and accreditations highlight the prestigious heritage and educational excellence of Kazan Federal University.

MBBS Fees at Kazan Federal University

The total fee for pursuing the 6-year MBBS program at Kazan Federal University is very affordable and represents significant savings compared to private medical colleges in India. 

The overall MBBS fees at Kazan Federal University is around ₹22-25 lakhs. This includes:

  • First Year Fee: ₹3.7 lakhs (1st installment of ₹1.7 lakhs + 2nd installment of ₹2 lakhs)
  • 2nd to 6th Year Fee: ₹3.3 lakhs per year 
  • Accommodation + Other Expenses: ₹1 lakh per year

Please Note: The university provides special discounts to meritorious Indian students. The fees are indicative and may vary based on current conversion rates. Please check with the university for the latest fee structure.

MBBS Specializations at Kazan Federal University

After completion of the MBBS program, students have the option to pursue specialization in the following major disciplines:

  • Internal Medicine with sub-specializations in Cardiology, gastroenterology, etc.
  • General Surgery with sub-specializations in Neurosurgery, Pediatric surgery, etc.
  • Obstetrics & Gynecology
  • Pediatrics  
  • Orthopaedics
  • ENT

KFU provides advanced practical exposure and training in these specializations to develop expert clinicians in respective areas of medicine.

Eligibility Criteria for MBBS in Kazan Federal University

Indian students must fulfill the below eligibility criteria to get admission to the MBBS program at Kazan Federal University:

  1. Completed Class 12th from a recognized board with minimum 60% marks in PCB subjects 
  2. Qualified NEET exam & obtained a valid NEET scorecard
  3. Completed 17 years of age on or before 31st December of the admission year
  4. Medically fit with a valid medical certificate

If you meet the above eligibility criteria, you can apply for direct admission for MBBS in Kazan Federal University based on your Class 12 results & NEET score. 

The university has a simple admission process without any entrance test or Russian language requirements.

Admission Process at Kazan Federal University

Following is the step-by-step admission process for MBBS in Kazan Federal University for Indian students:

  • Step 1: Submit your NEET scorecard, Class 12th mark sheet, passport copy, and other documents 
  • Step 2: Wait for the invitation letter from KFU within 1 week
  • Step 3: Pay the admission fees as per the first-year fee structure
  • Step 4: Receive the invitation letter for the student VISA application via email
  • Step 5: Apply for a student VISA with the necessary documents
  • Step 6: Book your tickets & depart for Russia after getting the VISA

That’s it! The simple admission process allows you to secure your seat for MBBS at KFU and embark on your journey as an international medical student within 2 to 3 weeks.

Required Documents

The below documents are required to be submitted to get admission in MBBS in Kazan Federal University:

  1. Class 10 and 12 mark sheets 
  2. Certificates showing PCB percentage in Class 12
  3. Valid NEET scorecard 
  4. International passport copies
  5. Migration certificate
  6. Medical fitness certificate
  7. Financial guarantor letter
  8. Passport size photographs

It is recommended to start the documentation process 1-2 months in advance. The university’s admission team guides students for any assistance required in document submission.

Career Opportunities After MBBS in Kazan Federal University

Pursuing an MBBS from Kazan Federal University opens up a myriad of rewarding career opportunities across the globe:

  • Practice as a doctor or pursue postgraduation in medicine in India after clearing FMGE/NEXT exam 
  • Appear for licensing exams like USMLE, and PLAB to practice in the USA, UK, Middle East, Europe, Australia, etc.
  • Work at leading public and private hospitals across major cities in India and abroad
  • Join as a healthcare/pharmaceutical professional in the government sector through UPSC
  • Pursue higher education through PhD and Research in the field of Medicine  
  • Join WHO, United Nations, or other global health agencies in various leadership roles

The globally recognized MBBS degree from KFU provides a stepping stone to thrive in the medical profession globally based on your interests and aspirations.

Accommodation and Hostel Facilities at Kazan Federal University

Kazan Federal University offers comfortable on-campus accommodation for international students within the hostel premises. Key facilities include:

  • Separate hostel blocks for boys and girls  
  • Shared rooms with 2 or 3 students in each room
  • Washrooms and bathrooms on each floor 
  • Centralized heating and hot water 
  • Laundry services are available
  • Internet connectivity in hostel rooms
  • Secure entrance and security staff
  • Cafeterias & canteens within walking distance

Staying on campus makes the transition smooth for international students. Off-campus private accommodation options with Russian host families are also available based on preference.

Student’s Life at Kazan Federal University

Beyond academics, KFU provides students with a vibrant campus life through various clubs, events, and extracurriculars:

Sports Complex – Courts for basketball, tennis, football, aquatics complex, and gymnasium.

Cultural Festivals like Unity of Peoples – Ramadan, Unity of Peoples – Navruz, etc. 

Student Organizations – Students Council, Debate Club, and more

Global Connect – Forums to interact with international students

Safari Tourism Club – Explore exotic destinations in Russia! 

Medical Conferences – Opportunities to publish research

Buddy Programs – Get connected with senior students 

The range of student activities, forums, and events at KFU help students become well-rounded individuals and make friends from around the world.

Our expert counselors provide end-to-end guidance, right from shortlisting MBBS colleges as per your profile, guiding the admission process, arranging for visa assistance, providing pre-departure guidance for travelling abroad, and more.

posts.title: Decoding NEET 2024 Cutoff- Marks You Need for MBBS Admissions
posts.content:
The National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET-UG), conducted by the National Testing Agency (NTA), is undoubtedly the most prestigious and toughest undergraduate Medical entrance examination in India. It is the gateway for students aspiring to Pursue MBBS and BDS courses in government and private institutions across the country.

Every year, over 22 lakh students appear for this exam, competing for around 109,000+ MBBS seats. Naturally, the competition is fierce.

The NEET cutoff marks are the minimum scores that candidates need to obtain for qualifying the exam. And becoming eligible for counseling processes.

While quota reservations provide some flexibility, going by previous years’ trends. The NEET 2024 cutoff for the general category may hover between 120 to 140 marks for students to stand a decent chance.

Let’s analyze the key factors that will influence NEET 2024 cutoffs:

  • Increasing Applicants & Limited Seats – Each successive year, more and more aspirants take the NEET exam. While the total number of seats has not increased proportionately over the past decade. Naturally, cutoffs are getting higher.
  • Previous Years’ Cutoff Trends – The NEET 2023 cutoff for the general category closed at 137 marks (out of 720 total). In 2022, it was 117 while 2021 and 2020 again saw 137 marks as the 50th percentile cutoff. This shows an overall rising pattern.
  • Level of Difficulty – If NTA introduces more application-based MCQs in NEET UG 2024. Scoring may become more challenging for test takers, directly impacting cutoffs. 
  • Reservation Policies – While the NEET exam itself has no reservation quota. Different medical colleges have defined minority reservations that indirectly influence general category cutoffs.

Accounting for these factors, an expected NEET 2024 cutoff for the general unreserved category may fall in the range of 135+ to 145 marks in order to safely get MBBS admission into a decent private medical college in India.

Of course, cutoffs also vary state-wise depending on the exam difficulty level, number of applications, and diversity of reservation policies applicable.

Let’s look at some predicted state-wise NEET 2024 qualifying cutoff marks:

Maharashtra: 144+

Karnataka: 136+

Uttar Pradesh: 140+

Rajasthan: 150+ 

Delhi: 150+

Students from the general category aiming for reputed private medical institutions like Manipal, BITS Pilani, Amrita School of Medicine, Saveetha University etc. Should secure 150+ scores for comfortably clearing initial admission shortlisting rounds.

On the other hand, for reserved categories like SC/ST/OBC, the NEET 2024 cutoff may be around 117-127 marks, as per last few years’ results. But economically disadvantaged students should still aim for 130+ for better college options.

Coming to admission into government medical colleges through NEET 2024, the competition is much more cut-throat, being highly preferred due to massive fee subsidies.

Here, general category cutoff predictions would be: 

AIIMS Delhi: 200+

Other Top Government Colleges: 170+ 

Thus, summing up the overall forecast – a safe NEET 2024 cutoff target is 137+ marks for general category aspirants, while reserved categories should chase at least 117 marks to get into their choice of private medical college in India. For government colleges, sky-high scores of 170+ and above are vital.

This brings us to the importance of early NEET exam preparation with an expert coaching institute. One such leading organization that students trust for MBBS in India counselling and study-course recommendations is AR Group of Education. They guide students wanting to pursue medical education across varied destinations like the Romania, Russia, Georgia, Bangladesh, China, Poland, etc., besides India.

With over a decade’s experience in academic counselling and test guidance services, AR Group of Education has helped numerous students achieve High NEET percentile scores for successful admission into Medical universities in India & abroad, offering affordable fee structures and quality education infrastructure.

Right from timely exam form fill-up assistance to regularly updating students on changing NEET eligibility rules, AR Group of Education’s able counselors recommend the most student-friendly MBBS study options suited to every applicant’s preferences, academic profile, and budget. Their transparent, ethical, and result-oriented advisory services enable aspiring doctors to realize their dreams through the best-matched medical programs in India & abroad.

Here are some useful NEET exam preparation and targeted score-enhancement tips for smoothly clearing the NEET UG 2024 cutoffs:

  • Start Early – Begin building NEET fundamentals from 11th grade onwards through NCERT textbooks. Don’t wait for the 12th standard to finish the vast Medical exam syllabus. 
  • Consistency – Only regular reading, critical thinking, and solve-work guarantee solid retention of concepts needed to apply in MCQ solving. Cramming won’t help reach High NEET Percentiles beyond just passing cutoffs.
  • Assess Progress – Take mock tests every quarter not just to gauge subject-level proficiency. But also to measure accuracy and time management—critical attributes tested in NEET.
  • Analyze Performance – Maintain an error logbook to review knowledge gaps that need strengthening through focused study. Keep honing your weak areas.
  • Time Management – NEET is a 180-minute test comprising 720 marks MCQ paper. Don’t spend over 1 minute per question or risk leaving questions unattempted, directly hitting scores. 
  • Balance Speed & Accuracy – Find an optimal question-solving pace through mock tests for maximizing attempted questions with high correctness. Avoid blind guesswork or careless errors.

Well, that’s the full NEET UG 2024 Cutoff decoded with expert tips. It’s time to put your game face on! You got this, future doctor! 

What after NEET UG Exam?

About 25 lakh students will appear for the NEET UG Exam 2024, and as per the data of the previous year (2023), only 11 lakh students qualified for the NEET UG Exam out of the total 22 lakh students who appeared for the exam. There are only 1.09 lakh seats in government colleges. Now the question arises, what happened to those who didn’t get admission in Government College? 

Drop is not a good option as it wastes a whole year cutting down on all the relations and connections from the outer environment is just a harsh truth of many students who choose to drop out. Many students choose to get admission in private medical colleges but the academic fees and accommodation is very costly in Indian private medical institutions which lie in the range of 45 lakh to 1.07 Cr. 

But a better option is to study MBBS abroad, as you will get the opportunity to study in government medical colleges abroad because of the lesser competition for seats and the more affordable medical education, which ranges from Rs 13 lakh, including food and accommodation.  

Conclusion–

Staying committed through the long NEET preparation journey can be challenging without a structured study plan or expert guidance. This is where enrolling under the guidance of experienced counselling organization like AR Group of Education. Pays rich mentoring in comfortably crossing the NEET 2024 Cutoff Targets right in your early exam attempts. Their time-tested mentoring programs handhold students to achieve high medical exam percentiles year after year.

posts.content:
Georgia is a country which has always been a hubspot for medical education from the past many decades and due to a developed infrastructure it promotes learning for a widely diverse community of students from varied origins across the globe so mbbs in Georgia is perfect choice. 

Georgia has emerged as one of the most popular destinations for Indian students looking to pursue MBBS abroad. With its high-quality medical education, affordable fees, and easy admission process, Georgia offers a compelling option for students wanting to become doctors. 

In this blog, we provide a comprehensive guide on MBBS in Georgia for Indian students looking to enroll in 2024. We cover everything from fees, eligibility, top universities, admission process, and more.

Why MBBS in Georgia 2024?

  • High FMGE/NEXT Passing Rate – The FMGE passing rate for graduates from Georgian medical colleges has been quite good over the past few years. This suggests students are getting high quality medical training.
  • Clinical Exposure – Medical students get extensive practical training and clinical rotation exposure at university hospitals in Georgia. This hands-on experience is invaluable for developing clinical skills. 
  • Globally Valid Degree – The MBBS degree awarded after completing the 6-year MD program is recognized globally including by the Medical Council of India(MCI). Graduates can practice anywhere. 
  • Diverse Patient Pool – The universities have a high patient inflow coming from various backgrounds. Interacting with diverse patients allows gaining exposure to different medical cases.
  • No Language Barrier – The entire curriculum is taught in English medium. Students don’t face language or communication issues during studying or with patients.  
  • Vibrant Student Life – Georgia offers an excellent combination of quality academics along with vibrant student life. The unique Georgian culture greatly enhances the overall student experience.
  • Easy Admission Process – There is no entrance exam requirement. Admission is based on Class 12th grades, NEET score and university screening. Very easy compared to India.
  • Affordable Fees – The tuition fees even at the top Georgian medical colleges are almost half compared to private colleges in India. This makes it very attractive.
  • Georgia ticks all the right boxes in terms of FMGE passing, clinical exposure, fees, quality of life and education standards. This makes it one of the best destinations for aspiring Indian doctors.

Why Choose Georgia for MBBS?

There are several reasons why Georgia has become a top choice for Indian students for studying medicine:

  • Affordable fees – Tuition for the entire MBBS program ranges from USD 5000 to 8000 per year. This is much lower compared to private medical colleges in India.
  • Good quality education – Georgian medical universities are recognized by MCI, WHO, and follow a rigorous academic curriculum. The FMGE passing rate is also decent.
  • English-taught programs – Classes are conducted fully in English medium, which eliminates language barriers. No IELTS/TOEFL required.  
  • Internationally recognized degrees – Upon completion, students receive a globally valid M.D. degree. Can practice anywhere after clearing licensing exams.
  • Vibrant student life – Georgia offers an amazing blend of quality education and lively student experience. The unique culture is also a huge draw.

MBBS in Georgia Key Statistics

  • 7000+ Indian students currently studying 
  • Duration of MBBS: 5 years + 1 year Internship
  • Medium of instruction: English 
  • MCI/NMC and WHO approved colleges
  • No donation or entrance exam

2. New Vision University

3. East European University

MBBS in Georgia for Indian Students Fees

After evaluating the fee structure across multiple medical universities and colleges to study MBBS in Georgia for Indian students fees ranges between 5000 to 8000 USD per year. In addition, living expenses would be around 200 to 300 USD per month.

MBBS in Georgia Eligibility

To apply for MBBS in Georgia, Indian students need:

  • 50% marks in Physics, Chemistry, Biology in 12th board
  • Valid NEET score with qualifying marks(NEET 2024 Scorecard will be submitted while applying) 
  • Completed a minimum of 17 years of age before 31st of December, 2024.

The admission process is simple and straightforward:

1. Shortlist universities and apply online with documents 

2. Get invitation letter from university

3. Pay tuition fees  

4. Apply for student visa

5. Fly to Georgia for MBBS program

The Conclusion

With its excellent medical education system, low cost of studying, favorable environment for Indian students, and straightforward admission process, Georgia has become a haven for Indian students wanting to become doctors. The country offers quality education along with global exposure and a unique cultural experience.

posts.title: NEET 2024 Exam Syllabus: What’s the Update?
posts.content:
The updated NEET 2024 Exam Syllabus comprises major changes for the first time in the decade and to get you updated we have brought all the necessary information in a much simplified manner.Many important topics from multiple units have been removed such as topics in Genetics and Evolution, Ecology and Human Physiology in Biology.

Medical aspirants who are ready with all their study material have to check the updated syllabus before crafting their priority list of topics which have more weightage. The updated NEET 2024 Exam Syllabus not only removed some topics but also added new ones in the list which are not included in NCERT syllabus.

NEET UG 2024 vs 2023 Exam Syllabus

For a Better understanding and to observe the changes carefully, you have to compare NEET 2024 Exam syllabus with NEET 2023 Exam Syllabus side by side to mark removed and enlist the added topics. These topics are included because these are taught among multiple State Boards like Uttar Pradesh State Board, Bihar State Board, etc.

NEET 2024 Exam Updated Syllabus Released by NTA

Updated NEET 2024 Exam Biology Syllabus

Subject which matters the most and the one in which you can score the highest. There are multiple topics across major units which are removed.

Here is the updated list of Units in Biology Syllabus for NEET 2024 Exam-

Unit I: Diversity in Living World

Unit II: Structural Organisation in Animals and Plants

Unit III: Cell Structure and Function

Unit IV: Plant Physiology

Unit V: Human physiology

Unit VI: Reproduction

Unit VII: Genetics and Evolution

Unit VIII: Biology and Human Welfare

Unit IX: Biotechnology and Its Applications

Unit X: Ecology and Environment

Excluded Topics in Biology:

  • Taxonomic Aid 
  • Angiosperm
  • Secondary Growth 
  • Transport in Plants except Xylem and Phloem
  • Mineral Nutrition 
  • Vernalization and Seed Dormancy  
  • Sense Organs 
  • Digestion and Absorption
  • Reproduction in Organisms 
  • Strategies for Enhancement in Food Production 
  • Succession
  • Environmental Issues

Incorporated Topics in Biology:

  • Family (Malvaceae, Cruciferae, Leguminosae, Compositae, Gramineae)
  • Insect (correct- “Frog”)

Points to Keep in Mind before coming on any conclusion:

  • As the Incorporated topics are not given in the NCERT Biology Book, you have to take reference from older editions of either NCERT Biology books or from biology reference books from other publications which should be an authentic source of information. 
  • No entire chapter has been removed from the NEET 2024 Biology Syllabus and only certain topics have been removed. 

Updated NEET 2024 Exam Physics Syllabus

Physics is known as the “Rank building subject” and this applies to most of the medical aspirants. This is a subject which comparatively needs more time and effort to cover the syllabus. This creates a borderline among the students who are focused and put effort on a daily basis but those who are taking it lightly can seriously lower down your rank.

As in Physics, most of the topics are conceptual and require complex calculations.

Here is the updated list of Units in Biology Syllabus for NEET 2024 Exam-

Unit I: Physics and Measurement

Unit II: Kinematics

Unit III: Laws of Motion

Unit IV: Work, Energy and Power

Unit V: Rotational Motion

Unit VI: Gravitation

Unit VII: Properties of Solids and Liquids

Unit VIII: Thermodynamics

Unit IX: Kinetic Theory of Gases

Unit X: Oscillations and Waves

Unit XI: Electrostatics

Unit XII: Current Electricity

Unit XIII: Magnetic Effects of Current and Magnetism

Unit XIV: Electromagnetic Induction And Alternating Currents

Unit XV: Electromagnetic Waves

Unit XVI: Optics

Unit XVII: Dual Nature of Matter and Radiation

Unit XVIII: Atoms and Nuclei

Unit XIX: Electronic Devices

Unit XX: Experimental Skills

Excluded Topics in Physics:

  • Rolling Motion
  • Reynold’s Number
  • Heat Engine & Refrigerator
  • Forced and Damped Oscillation
  • Doppler Effect
  • Van de Graaff Generator
  • Colour Coding of Resistors
  • Potentiometer
  • Cyclotron
  • Davisson-Germer Experiment
  • Alpha, Beta, Gamma Decay
  • Transistor

Updated NEET 2024 Exam Chemistry Syllabus

With a dedicated approach and minimal effort you surely excel in chemistry and by regular practice especially in chapters of organic chemistry section, you can gain much higher scores in NEET 2024 Exam.

Physical Chemistry Syllabus for NEET

Look at the Units Included physical chemistry section in the updated NEET 2024 Exam Chemistry Syllabus-

Unit I: Some Basic Concepts of Chemistry

Unit II: Atomic Structure

Unit III: Chemical Bonding and Molecular Structure

Unit IV: Chemical Thermodynamics

Unit V: Solutions

Unit VI: Equilibrium 

Unit VII: Redox Reactions and Electrochemistry

Unit VIII: Chemical Kinetics

Inorganic Chemistry Syllabus for NEET

Look at the Units Included inorganic chemistry section in the updated NEET 2024 Exam Chemistry Syllabus-

Unit IX: Classification in Elements and Periodicity in Properties

Unit X: P-Block Elements

Unit XI: d and f Block Elements

Unit XII: Coordination Compounds

Organic Chemistry Syllabus for NEET

Look at the Units Included organic chemistry section in the updated NEET 2024 Exam Chemistry Syllabus-

Unit XIII: Purification and Characterisation of Organic Compounds

Unit XIV: Some Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry

Unit XV: Hydrocarbons

Unit XVI: Organic Compounds Containing Halogen

Unit XVII: Organic Compound Containing Oxygen

Unit XVIII: Organic Compounds Containing Nitrogen

Unit XIX: Biomolecules

Unit XX: Principles Related to Practical Chemistry

Excluded Topics in Chemistry:

Topics of Class 11

  • States of Matter (Physical Chemistry)
  • Hydrogen (Inorganic Chemistry)
  • S-block  (Inorganic Chemistry)
  • Environmental Chemistry (Organic Chemistry)

Topics of Class 12

  • Solid State (Physical Chemistry)
  • Surface Chemistry (Physical Chemistry)
  • Metallurgy (Inorganic Chemistry)
  • Polymer Chemistry in Everyday Life (Organic Chemistry)

Conclusion

The more you focus towards your preparation for the NEET 2024 Exam you will get clarity over the topics you have to cover first. For that, the first step is to get the whole updated syllabus. And your first requirement is already fulfilled by us, so the next step is to check what you have covered till now and what to prepare for. The choices and hierarchy of topics should be according to the weightage of the topics for NEET 2024 Exam. 

Our best wishes with you, that you may get your desired Medical College. If you need any assistance or support feel free to connect with AR Group of Education so that you get proper guidance if you want to study in Private Medical Colleges in India or Medical Colleges in Abroad.

posts.title: From NEET PG to NExT Exam: Changes to Chances
posts.content:
NExT EXAM is a mandatory examination conducted by the Commission or an approved authority in India. It serves two purposes. First, it certifies whether a medical graduate is eligible to practice modern medicine in the country, essentially acting as a Licentiate Examination. Second, it determines the eligibility and ranking of individuals who wish to pursue further education in postgraduate medical specialties. In this regard, it also functions as an entrance examination for admission to postgraduate medical courses. You can learn more about this as you continue reading!

Shedding Light on NExT EXAM

  • It applies to various categories of individuals. Firstly, it includes all undergraduate medical students enrolled in MBBS programs across Medical Colleges approved by the National Medical Commission, including Institutes of National Importance.
  • Secondly, it encompasses Abroad Medical Graduates who meet the requirements specified by the National Medical Commission for obtaining a license to practice medicine in India and for enrollment in the State Register or National Register. The regulations determine the specific manner in which these individuals can pursue these actions.
  • Thirdly, individuals with a Medical Degree who intend to pursue academic courses, observerships, or any other purposes specified and approved by the National Medical Commission through official notifications or regulations fall under the scope of NExT.
  • Lastly, those who have already been granted a license to practice medicine and are registered in the National Medical Register or State Medical Register, and who wish to seek admission to Postgraduate courses in broad medical specialties, are also subject to the NExT examination

NEXT EXAM Step 1 

  • The first step of the NExt Exam will be a theory examination.
  • The questions in this examination will be of the multiple-choice type.
  • The exam will be conducted online using a computer-based format.
  • The specific procedures for conducting common counseling for admission to postgraduate medical courses will be determined by the Commission and notified by the Government of India.
  • Students who have completed their III MBBS/Final MBBS from a recognized medical college approved by the Commission will be eligible to take the NExT Step 1 exam.

Now Get the Opportunities Twice

The Step 1 exams will be held twice a year, in May and November, or as notified by the Commission. Candidates are allowed multiple attempts to pass NExT Step 1 and Step 2 exams within 10 years of joining the MBBS course. However, candidates can only take the Step 1 exam to improve their scores after completing the Step 2 exam. The NExT Step 1 will replace the conventional university/institutional theory exams for III MBBS/Final MBBS Part II. Practical/clinical exams for III MBBS/Final MBBS will continue to be conducted in the conventional manner unless notified otherwise by the Commission.

Syllabus of NEXT Step 1 

The NExT examination will consist of six papers that cover subjects from III MBBS/Final MBBS, both Part 1 and Part 2. The subjects covered are:
●  Medicine and allied disciplines
●   Surgery and allied disciplines
●   Obstetrics and Gynaecology
●   Pediatrics
●   Otorhinolaryngology
●   Ophthalmology
These papers will include the applied aspects of all subjects covered under I MBBS, II MBBS, and III MBBS/Final MBBS Part 1.

Next step 2 

The NExT examination’s second step, known as NExT Step 2, focuses on evaluating practical/clinical skills, clinical decision-making, and communication skills expected of an Indian Medical Graduate. It is an Objective Structured Clinical Case-based examination that involves simulated cases or patients.

The examination is conducted in person by the respective state Health Universities/Institutions, following the standards and guidelines provided by the Commission. In cases where state Health Universities do not exist, the Commission determines the authorized University/Institution to conduct NExT Step 2 for the respective colleges.

Regular NExT Step 2 Examinations are held twice a year, and there is also a NExT Step 2 Supplementary Examination conducted twice a year. The supplementary examination is specifically for candidates who have failed in one or more of the seven subjects and need to repeat those subjects. If a candidate fails in more than three subjects, they must appear in all seven subjects again in the supplementary examination.

There is no limit to the number of attempts a candidate can make in NExT Step 2, as long as they have passed both NExT Step 1 and NExT Step 2 Examinations within 10 years of joining the MBBS Course.

Syllabus of next step 2 

NExT Step 2 is a Practical/Clinical and Viva Voce Examination.The purpose of NExT Step 2 is to assess practical skills, clinical knowledge, and decision-making abilities of the candidates.

● It covers seven clinical subjects/disciplines, including Medicine and allied disciplines, Surgery and allied disciplines, Obstetrics and Gynaecology, Paediatrics, Otorhinolaryngology, Ophthalmology, and Orthopaedics and PMR (Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation).
● The examination is conducted in an Objective Structured format.
● It is a Clinical Case Based examination, meaning that it focuses on real-life clinical scenarios.

Eligibility for Provisional Internship

Indian Medical Graduate: A student from a recognized medical college in India is eligible for compulsory rotating internship if they meet the following criteria:
a) Pass all six theory papers of NExT Step 1.
b) Pass the practical/clinical examination of III MBBS/Final MBBS (Part 2) regulated by the university/institution.

Foreign Medical Graduate:

A student who completed their medical education overseas and fulfills the requirements specified by the Foreign Medical Graduate Regulations of the Commission is eligible for compulsory rotating internship if they pass all six theory papers of NExT Step 1.

Eligibility for Medical Registration and Practice

Indian Medical Graduate or Foreign Medical Graduate: To be registered in the National Medical Register/State Medical Register and obtain a license to practice medicine in India, the following conditions must be met:

a) Completion of the required duration of internship as applicable.
b) Passing the NExT Step 2 practical/clinical examination.
c) Meeting the requirements stated in the Registration of Medical Practitioners and License to Practice Medicine Regulations of the National Medical Commission.
d) Fulfillment of any other requirements specified by the Commission.
Eligibility for Postgraduate Medical Courses:

Graduates with Medical Registration: Those who have obtained a license to practice medicine and are registered in the National Medical Register/State Medical Register are eligible for admission to postgraduate medical courses in broad specialty subjects, provided they meet the following criteria:
a) Eligible and granted a license to practice modern medicine in India.
b) Participation in the common counseling process as prescribed by the Commission through an approved designated authority.

Apart from the mentioned eligibility criteria, the NExT Step 1 scores can be used by the Government of India, State Governments, and other organizations for purposes such as employment, scholarships, fellowships, etc.

Note: The MBBS degree is awarded upon passing the Final MBBS examination and successfully completing a one-year internship.

posts.title: NEET UG Official Answer Key 2023 Released
posts.content:
The national eligibility entrance test for undergraduate or NEET UG 2023 , answer key was made public by the National Testing Agency ( NTA)  on 13 June 2023. The organization has previously stated that the NEET UG 2023 result and the official answer key will be released jointly. On the official website, neet.nta.nic.in as well as ntaresults.nic.in, applicants who took the exam can view the answer key and results. 

The NEET UG 2023 test was given on May 7. 20,87,449 students took the exams at 4,097 locations in 499 cities. On June 13, 2023, the results of the NEET UG were released. For the convenience of the candidates, the testing organisation has now made the final answer key of the exam public. With 720 points, Prabhanjan J and Bora Varun Chakravarthi have achieved Rank 1. Kaustav Bauri finished third with a score of 716. 

NEET UG Final Answer Key 2023: How to download

 Here are the steps to download the final answer key for NEET UG 2023 : 

  • Open your web browser and visit the official website of NTA NEET at neet.nta.nic.in.
  • look for the “NEET UG Final Answer Key 2023” link.
  • Click on the “NEET UG Final Answer Key 2023” link, and a new page will load.
  • On the new page, a PDF file containing the answer key will open automatically.
  • Take your time to carefully review the answers provided in the PDF file, comparing them with your own responses from the NEET examination.
  • If necessary, you can download the PDF file by clicking on the download button usually located on the top right corner of the PDF viewer.
  • Once the file is downloaded, You can either print it out or save it in a secure location on your device.
Over 20 lakh students enrolled for NEET UG 2023, while 8,81,967 male candidates showed up for the test. A remarkable 4,90,374 of the applicants among them were qualified. On the other hand, there were 11,56,618 more female applicants who registered and showed up for the test. Outstandingly, 6,55,599 female candidates passed the medical examination.
 
Visit Now :- NEET UG Rank Predictor 2023
 
NEET UG 2023 Important dates 
The NEET UG exam was conducted on May 7, 2023. In Manipur, the NEET UG exam took place on June 6, 2023. The provisional answer key for NEET was released on June 4, 2023. Candidates were given until June 6, 2023, at 11:50 PM to challenge the provisional answer key. For Manipur candidates, the last date to challenge the provisional answer key was June 12, 2023, till 4 pm.
 The final answer key for NEET was released on June 13, 2023. On the same day, June 13, 2023, the NEET results were also announced.
 

NEET UG 2023 Marking Scheme 

After the completion of the NEET 2023 exam, the NTA officials will allot marks to the candidates based on the marking scheme. Here is the marking scheme for NEET 2023:
 
Correct Answer: For each correct answer, candidates will be awarded four marks (+4).
Incorrect Answer: For each incorrect answer, one mark will be deducted (-1).
 
Unanswered: If a question is left unanswered, no marks will be allotted (0).
To calculate the NEET UG scores, candidates can use the following formula:
 
NEET marks = (4 X total correct answers) – (1 X total incorrect answers)
 
By applying this formula, candidates can determine their NEET scores based on the number of correct and incorrect answers they have provided in the exam.

posts.content:
MBBS is a highly reputed undergraduate program in the field of medicine, with several esteemed medical colleges offering this course in Uttar Pradesh. The duration of the MBBS course in Uttar Pradesh is 5.5 years, including one year of internship.

The admission process for MBBS in Uttar Pradesh is on the basis of the National Eligibility cum Entrance Test (NEET). Candidates who have completed their 10+2 education with Physics, Chemistry, and Biology as compulsory subjects are eligible to appear for NEET. Based on their NEET scores, candidates can participate in the counselling process for admission to MBBS colleges in Uttar Pradesh.

While NEET is the preferred entrance examination, some universities in Uttar Pradesh may also conduct their own entrance exams for MBBS admissions. However, NEET scores hold crucial weightage in the admission process. Aspiring MBBS candidates should thoroughly research and verify the eligibility criteria, admission process, and other details of their preferred colleges before submitting their applications to take admission to MBBS in U.P.

Entrance ModeNEET
FrequencyOnce a year

UP MBBS Admission 2023: Eligibility Criteria

  • Minimum 50% marks in English, Physics, Chemistry, and Biology for the general category.
  • SC/ST/OBC candidates require a minimum of 40% marks in each subject.
  • Physically handicapped candidates (general category) need at least 45% marks in the specified subjects.
  • Residents of Uttar Pradesh or those who passed the 10+2 exams from Uttar Pradesh are eligible.
  • NEET entrance exam appearance and registration for counselling are mandatory.

UP MBBS Admission Process 2023

  • Register on the official website and pay a registration fee of INR 2000.
  • Pay a refundable security deposit via Demand Draft to the Directorate of Medical Education and Training.
  • Verify documents at the designated nodal centres within the given timeframe.
  • Log in and select preferred colleges in order of preference.
  • DMET reviews preferences and releases the seat allotment list.
  • Report to the allotted college before the specified deadline.

posts.title: NEET UG 2023: Answer Key and OMR Response Sheets are Now Available On neet.nta.nic.in
posts.content:
The National Testing Agency (NTA) has released the Provisional Answer Keys, Scanned Images of OMR Answer Sheets, and Recorded Responses for the National Eligibility Entrance Test (UG) – 2023. The examination was conducted on 7th May 2023, with a total of 2,087,449 candidates appearing at 4,097 different centres across 499 cities in India, including 14 cities outside the country.

To ensure credibility and provide candidates with an opportunity to challenge the provisional Answer Key, NTA has made the materials available on their official website: https://neet.nta.nic.in. Candidates can challenge the Answer Key by paying a non-refundable processing fee of ₹200 per answer challenged. The challenge window is open from 4th June 2023 to 6th June 2023, up to 11:50 PM (IST). Candidates can also contest the OMR grading by submitting representations and paying a non-refundable processing fee of ₹200 per question challenged.

Direct Link to Check NEET UG Rank Predictor

It is important to note that the processing fee must be paid through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, or Paytm by 6th June 2023, 11:50 PM (IST). Challenges without the receipt of the processing fee will not be entertained, and no other mode of challenge submission will be accepted.

The challenges submitted by candidates will be thoroughly verified by a panel of subject experts. If any challenge is found to be valid, the Answer Key will be revised accordingly, and the revised Final Answer Key will be applied to all candidates’ responses. The result will be prepared and declared based on this final key. It is worth mentioning that individual candidates will not be informed about the acceptance or non-acceptance of their challenges.

NEET UG 2023 Provisional Answer Key: How to Check 

● Visit the official website of NEET at neet.nta.nic.in.

● On the homepage, navigate to the section titled “NEET UG 2023 Answer Key – Download.”

● Click on the designated link to proceed.

● You will be directed to a login page. Enter your NEET application number and password in the respective fields.

● After entering the required details, submit the form.

● A PDF file containing the NEET UG 2023 answer key will be displayed on the screen.

● Review the answer key and compare it with your responses to evaluate your performance.

● If needed, you can download the answer key by clicking on the download button.

● It is recommended to take a printout of the answer key for future reference and further analysis.

The NEET 2023 exam date remained May 7, 2023, for applicants whose exam sites were located in states other than Manipur. Over 20 lakh applicants took the medical entrance exam using pen and paper mode. The NEET UG 2023 exam will take place between 2:00 P.M and 5:20 PM. Aspirants from Manipur must arrive at the designated NEET 2023  exam site by the time specified on their admit card.

NTA to Announce NEET UG 2023 Exam Schedule for Manipur Candidates Soon. The exam will be held on any date between June 3 and June 5 and will be conducted using pen and paper.

Will NEET UG 2023 be conducted twice?

According to the most recent information, NTA will stop conducting NEET twice yearly as of 2023. Only candidates for Manipur whose prior tests were postponed will be allowed to take the exam. People can go to nta.nic.in or neet.nta.nic.in to get the most recent information about NEET 2023.

As per the latest notification from the National Testing Agency (NTA), the Manipur NEET 2023 exam will be conducted on any date between June 3 and June 5, 2023.

The duration of the NEET 2023 exam will be 3 hours and 20 minutes, starting at 2:00 PM and ending at 5:20 PM. It is important for candidates to be aware of the gate closing time, which is set at 1:30 PM. Candidates must ensure that they reach the examination centre well before the gate closing time to avoid any inconvenience.

The question paper will be distributed at 1:45 PM, and the examination will begin at 2:00 PM. Candidates are advised to be present at the examination centre on time and be prepared to start the examination promptly. The NEET examination will conclude at 5:20 PM. These timings and dates are subject to the official announcement and candidates are advised to refer to the NTA notifications for any updates or changes in the schedule
